workflow.critical: All NFR targets MUST be measurable with specific numbers

step.goal: Load context and identify NFR scope
step.action: Identify all NFR-relevant aspects from the loaded context: - Performance implications (data volumes, user counts, response expectations) - Security requirements (auth, data sensitivity, compliance needs) - Scalability needs (growth projections, peak vs normal load) - Reliability expectations (uptime needs, data criticality) - Observability needs (debugging, monitoring, alerting)
step.output:
## NFR Scope Analysis
Based on the requirements and architecture, here are the NFR categories that need attention:
{{nfr_categories_summary}}
Proceeding to detailed analysis for each category.

step.action: Analyze all performance-sensitive operations from requirements
step.questions: Create questions file if any of these are unclear: - Expected concurrent users (normal and peak) - Acceptable response times for key operations - Data volume expectations (current and 12-month projection) - Batch processing requirements and windows - Real-time vs near-real-time vs eventual consistency needs
step.action: Document performance targets with specific numbers: - API response time targets (p50, p95, p99) - Throughput targets (requests per second) - Database query time limits - Page load time targets (if UI) - Batch processing time windows
Analyze security needs from requirements and architecture

Document security requirements referencing standards: - Authentication method and requirements - Authorization model (RBAC, ABAC, etc.) - Data encryption (at rest and in transit) - Input validation standards (reference OWASP A03) - Session management requirements - API security (rate limiting, API keys, OAuth) - Secrets management approach - Audit logging requirements for security events - Vulnerability scanning requirements
Reference specific OWASP Top 10 categories where applicable

Document scalability targets: - Horizontal scaling targets (min/max instances) - Vertical scaling limits - Database scaling strategy - Storage growth projections - Cache sizing requirements - Connection pool sizing - Message queue throughput targets

Document reliability targets: - Uptime SLA (99.9%, 99.95%, 99.99%) - Recovery Time Objective (RTO) - Recovery Point Objective (RPO) - Failover requirements - Data durability targets - Backup frequency and retention - Disaster recovery requirements - Circuit breaker and retry policies

Document observability requirements: - Logging standards (structured logging, log levels) - Metrics collection (application, infrastructure, business) - Distributed tracing requirements - Alerting thresholds and escalation paths - Dashboard requirements - Health check endpoints - Error tracking and reporting
Compile all NFR categories into the template
Assign unique identifiers: NFR-PERF-001, NFR-SEC-001, etc.
Set priority for each NFR (Critical, High, Medium, Low)
Map each NFR to related functional requirements
Run content validation on the output
